correctness.rationale: On an orthogonal quotient torus the minimizing coordinate displacement (X,Y) is uniform in the centered unit square independently of the starting phase U=(qx0−py0) mod1, which is Haar-uniform because gcd(p,q)=1. An interior transverse intersection is exactly a crossing of an integer by U+t(qX−pY), hence N=|floor(U+qX−pY)|. Conditional on W=|qX−pY|, N=floor(W)+Bernoulli({W}), whose convolution trapezoid density yields a rational piecewise-hat probability mass law. Averaging W gives mu=(3a²+b²)/(12a), and Haar uniformity of {qX−pY} gives the Bernoulli variance-correction mean 1/6, so nu=(a²+b²+2)/12. Since gcd(a,b)=1, gcd(3a²+b²,a)=1 and denom(12mu)=a. The quadratic for a from S=12nu−2=a²+b² selects the larger nonnegative root; the shape ratio profile 144(1+r²)/(3+r²)^2 goes from 16 to18. Independent exact Fraction integration recovered all five named direction PMFs and moments, including axial and diagonal boundary directions. The a=b endpoint only occurs at a=b=1 by primitivity. No finite test is used for the universal argument.
residual_risks: Noise-free rational denominator recovery is ill-conditioned under empirical sampling; no finite-sample claim made.
Nonorthogonal lattice Voronoi cells are not axis-aligned and are outside scope.

value.rationale: PASS: the inverse problem of recovering a primitive integral homology class, up to signs and axis exchange, from a scalar marked random-intersection statistic is a natural exact marked-length/intersection invariant. The metric aspect invariance and exact integer denominator extraction are nontrivial: these distinguish a topological homology parameter from geometric shape without a noisy-data claim. The complete rational count law and second moment provide independently useful information.
residual_risks: Inverse identifies only the unordered absolute pair, not orientations and signs.

limitations: Rectangular orthogonal flat tori and Haar-uniform endpoint pairs only; no general skew lattice.
N counts transverse interior intersections almost surely, not algebraic signs.
Exact noiseless means are necessary for denominator extraction.
